Celebrate Independence Day with Megh
2018-03-13T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/news-flash/celebrate-independence-day-megh-1547092

Fashion house Megh has brought their latest collection of panjabis, saris, children's frocks, and t-shirts to celebrate the upcoming Independence Day. These comfortable clothes in red and green are bound to fit the tone of the occasion.
